```{r source-formulation}
#Source the pipeline (BaseMDP -> POMDP)
source("POMDPFormulation.R")
library(scales)

palette_policy <- c("Optimal MDP" = "#213C51", "POMDP (PBVI)" = "#574964",
                    "MCDA (TOPSIS)" = "#5A7863", "No Intervention" = "darkred")

theme_paper <- theme(
  panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
  panel.background = element_blank(),
  axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
  plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20),
  axis.text = element_text(size = 15),
  text = element_text(size = 18),
  legend.position = "bottom",
  legend.text = element_text(size = 14)
)
```

```{r panel-A-sweep}
#Panel A: Observation quality sweep
set.seed(42)
p_sn_levels <- seq(0.20, 1.00, by = 0.05)
N_sweep <- 300; T_sweep <- 15
obs_results <- data.frame()

for (p_sn in p_sn_levels) {
  print(paste0("p_SN = ", p_sn))
  O_mod <- O_mat
  O_mod[2, ] <- (1 - p_sn) / (K - 1)
  O_mod[2, 2] <- p_sn
  bp <- generate_belief_points(K, n_random = 80)
  pomdp_mod <- pbvi_solve(A, O_mod, R_mat, gamma_disc, bp,
                          max_horizon = 300, tol = 0.001, V_init = vi$V)
  for (pol_name in c("Optimal MDP", "POMDP (PBVI)", "MCDA (TOPSIS)", "No Intervention")) {
    rews <- numeric(N_sweep)
    for (i in 1:N_sweep) {
      if (pol_name == "Optimal MDP") {
        tr <- gillespie_mdp(Q_rate, vi$policy, c_rate, 1, T_sweep, r_disc)
      } else if (pol_name == "POMDP (PBVI)") {
        tr <- gillespie_pomdp(Q_rate, A, pomdp_mod$Gamma, pomdp_mod$actions,
                              O_mod, c_rate, 1, T_sweep, r_disc)
      } else if (pol_name == "MCDA (TOPSIS)") {
        tr <- gillespie_mcda(Q_rate, mcda_ideal_action, O_mod, mcda_dwell_time,
                             c_rate, 1, T_sweep, r_disc)
      } else {
        tr <- gillespie_mdp(Q_rate, policy_none, c_rate, 1, T_sweep, r_disc)
      }
      rews[i] <- tr$disc_return
    }
    obs_results <- rbind(obs_results, data.frame(
      p_sn = p_sn, policy = pol_name,
      mean_reward = mean(rews), se = sd(rews) / sqrt(N_sweep)))
  }
}

obs_results$policy <- factor(obs_results$policy,
  levels = c("Optimal MDP", "POMDP (PBVI)", "MCDA (TOPSIS)", "No Intervention"))
print(paste0("Panel A sweep complete."))
```

```{r panel-B-sweep}
#Panel B: Repair probability sensitivity sweep
set.seed(42)
rho_base <- matrix(0, nrow = M, ncol = K, dimnames = list(actions, states))
rho_base["DwSensorA", "SensorNoisy"] <- 0.60
rho_base["DwSensorB", "SensorNoisy"] <- 0.60
rho_base["IncFilter", "SensorNoisy"] <- 0.40
rho_base["ReidentPlant", "DynamicsOff"] <- 0.70
rho_base["BiasCorrect", "Drift"] <- 0.80

lambda_levels <- seq(0.1, 1.0, by = 0.1)
N_rep <- 300; T_rep <- 15
repair_results <- data.frame()

for (lam in lambda_levels) {
  print(paste0("lambda = ", lam))
  rho_s <- rho_base * lam
  A_new <- list()
  for (a in actions) {
    A_new[[a]] <- A_NoAction
    for (s in 1:K) {
      if (rho_s[a, s] > 0) {
        r <- rho_s[a, s]
        A_new[[a]][s, ] <- (1 - r) * A_NoAction[s, ]
        A_new[[a]][s, 1] <- A_new[[a]][s, 1] + r
      }
    }
  }
  Q_new <- lapply(A_new, function(Aa) {
    Qa <- (Aa - diag(K)) / dt; dimnames(Qa) <- list(states, states); Qa
  })
  vi_new <- value_iteration(A_new, R_mat, gamma_disc)
  c_rate_new <- R_mat / dt
  bp <- generate_belief_points(K, n_random = 80)
  pomdp_new <- pbvi_solve(A_new, O_mat, R_mat, gamma_disc, bp,
                          max_horizon = 300, tol = 0.001, V_init = vi_new$V)
  for (pol_name in c("Optimal MDP", "POMDP (PBVI)", "MCDA (TOPSIS)", "No Intervention")) {
    rews <- numeric(N_rep)
    for (i in 1:N_rep) {
      if (pol_name == "Optimal MDP") {
        tr <- gillespie_mdp(Q_new, vi_new$policy, c_rate_new, 1, T_rep, r_disc)
      } else if (pol_name == "POMDP (PBVI)") {
        tr <- gillespie_pomdp(Q_new, A_new, pomdp_new$Gamma, pomdp_new$actions,
                              O_mat, c_rate_new, 1, T_rep, r_disc)
      } else if (pol_name == "MCDA (TOPSIS)") {
        tr <- gillespie_mcda(Q_new, vi_new$policy, O_mat, mcda_dwell_time,
                             c_rate_new, 1, T_rep, r_disc)
      } else {
        policy_n <- setNames(rep("NoAction", K), states)
        tr <- gillespie_mdp(Q_new, policy_n, c_rate_new, 1, T_rep, r_disc)
      }
      rews[i] <- tr$disc_return
    }
    repair_results <- rbind(repair_results, data.frame(
      lambda = lam, policy = pol_name,
      mean_reward = mean(rews), se = sd(rews) / sqrt(N_rep)))
  }
}

repair_results$policy <- factor(repair_results$policy,
  levels = c("Optimal MDP", "POMDP (PBVI)", "MCDA (TOPSIS)", "No Intervention"))
print(paste0("Panel B sweep complete."))
```

```{r panel-C-voi}
#Panel C: VoI bar chart (1000 trajectories per policy, T=20)
set.seed(42)
N_voi <- 1000
voi_data <- data.frame()

for (pol_name in c("Optimal MDP", "POMDP (PBVI)", "MCDA (TOPSIS)", "No Intervention")) {
  rews <- numeric(N_voi)
  for (i in 1:N_voi) {
    if (pol_name == "Optimal MDP") {
      tr <- gillespie_mdp(Q_rate, vi$policy, c_rate, 1, 20, r_disc)
    } else if (pol_name == "POMDP (PBVI)") {
      tr <- gillespie_pomdp(Q_rate, A, pomdp$Gamma, pomdp$actions, O_mat, c_rate, 1, 20, r_disc)
    } else if (pol_name == "MCDA (TOPSIS)") {
      tr <- gillespie_mcda(Q_rate, mcda_ideal_action, O_mat, mcda_dwell_time, c_rate, 1, 20, r_disc)
    } else {
      tr <- gillespie_mdp(Q_rate, policy_none, c_rate, 1, 20, r_disc)
    }
    rews[i] <- tr$disc_return
  }
  voi_data <- rbind(voi_data, data.frame(policy = pol_name, mean_ret = mean(rews)))
}

voi_data$policy <- factor(voi_data$policy,
  levels = c("Optimal MDP", "POMDP (PBVI)", "MCDA (TOPSIS)", "No Intervention"))

print(paste0("VoI (MDP - POMDP) = ", round(voi_data$mean_ret[1] - voi_data$mean_ret[2], 2)))
print(paste0("Planning advantage (POMDP - MCDA) = ", round(voi_data$mean_ret[2] - voi_data$mean_ret[3], 2)))
```

```{r plot-figure4, fig.width=14, fig.height=14}
p4a <- ggplot(obs_results, aes(x = p_sn, y = mean_reward, colour = policy, fill = policy)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_reward - 1.96 * se, ymax = mean_reward + 1.96 * se),
              alpha = 0.12, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) + geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = palette_policy) + scale_fill_manual(values = palette_policy) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0.2, 1.0, 0.1), labels = percent) +
  labs(tag = "A", title = "Reward vs SensorNoisy Classification Accuracy",
       x = expression(p[SN] ~ "(SensorNoisy accuracy)"),
       y = "Mean Cumulative Discounted Reward", colour = "Policy", fill = "Policy") +
  theme_paper

p4b <- ggplot(repair_results, aes(x = lambda, y = mean_reward, colour = policy, fill = policy)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_reward - 1.96 * se, ymax = mean_reward + 1.96 * se),
              alpha = 0.12, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) + geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = palette_policy) + scale_fill_manual(values = palette_policy) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0.1, 1.0, 0.1)) +
  labs(tag = "B", title = "Reward vs Repair Probability Scaling Factor",
       x = expression(lambda ~ "(repair probability scale)"),
       y = "Mean Cumulative Discounted Reward", colour = "Policy", fill = "Policy") +
  theme_paper

p4c <- ggplot(voi_data, aes(x = policy, y = mean_ret, fill = policy)) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.85, width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(mean_ret, 1)), vjust = -0.3, size = 5, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = palette_policy) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(tag = "C", title = "Value of Information Decomposition",
       x = NULL, y = "Mean Discounted Return") +
  theme_paper + theme(legend.position = "none")

grid.arrange(p4a, p4b, p4c, ncol = 1, heights = c(1, 1, 0.8))
```
